rationale: The stock gapped up ~6.2% on no news catalyst, opened at $16.65, hit a high of $16.89 in the first minute, then sold off sharply to $15.96 before partially recovering to $16.27 — now sitting below VWAP ($16.43) and the 9-EMA ($16.59), in the lower third of today's range. The price action shows a classic gap-and-fade with heavy early volume (2.2x relative), but the current location between the session low and VWAP offers no clean directional edge: a short risks a bounce back toward VWAP/EMA, while a long faces the overhead supply from the gap fill and the wide 80bps spread that erodes any small-range trade. The setup lacks a defined structural level to anchor a thesis with acceptable risk/reward.
